business_summary: Atom Livin Tech Co., Ltd. plans, develops, and sells interior hardware products in Japan. It offers door locks; hinges; slide hinges; swing door fittings; hinged door hardware; sliding door locks and hardware; top-hung sliding door fittings; movable partition fittings; folding door fittings; aluminum interior fittings; handles and pulls; slide rails and wire baskets; storage and hanging hardware; clothes drying fixtures and other fittings; brass antiques; and other furniture hardware under the ATOM brand name. The company sells its products through online and in hardware stores. It serves furniture manufacturers, construction hardware stores, house builders, building material manufacturers, architectural hardware stores, and housing equipment manufacturers. Atom Livin Tech Co., Ltd. was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.
